run: set -eux; extensions_dir=/opt/atelier/vscode-extensions; apt-get update; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gpg; install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings; curl -fsSL https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.microsoft.gpg; echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/packages.microsoft.gpg] https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/code stable main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.list; apt-get update; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends code; code --version --no-sandbox --user-data-dir /tmp/code-version; install -d -o atelier -g atelier /home/atelier/.vscode-server "$extensions_dir"; chown -R atelier:atelier "$extensions_dir"; su atelier -c 'ATELIER_VSCODE_HOST=127.0.0.1 nohup atelier-start-vscode > /tmp/vscode-prewarm.log 2>&1 &'; for i in $(seq 1 120); do body="$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/ 2>/dev/null || true)"; echo "$body" | grep -qi "workbench" && break; sleep 1; if [ "$i" = 120 ]; then cat /tmp/vscode-prewarm.log; echo "VS Code server prewarm timed out" >&2; exit 1; fi; done; pkill -u atelier -f 'code serve-web|code-server' || true; su atelier -c "/home/atelier/.vscode/cli/serve-web/*/bin/code-server --extensions-dir $extensions_dir --list-extensions --show-versions" | tee /tmp/vscode-extensions.log; grep -x 'atelier.atelier-diff-bridge@.*' /tmp/vscode-extensions.log; chmod -R a+rX /home/atelier/.vscode /home/atelier/.vscode-server "$extensions_dir"; find "$extensions_dir" -type d -exec chmod 0755 {} +; find "$extensions_dir" -type f -exec sh -c 'for file do magic="$(head -c 4 "$file" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d " ")"; first2="$(head -c 2 "$file")"; if [ "$magic" = "7f454c46" ] || [ "$first2" = "#!" ]; then chmod 0755 "$file"; fi; done' sh {} +; apt-get purge -y code gpg; apt-get autoremove -y; rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.list /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.microsoft.gpg /tmp/code-version /tmp/vscode-prewarm.log /tmp/vscode-extensions.log
